title: Register with Minnesota Secure Choice or certify a retirement plan exemption
authority: Minnesota Secure Choice Retirement Program Board
description: Private employers with five or more employees and no qualified plan must enroll in the program or file an exemption, on a staggered schedule: 100 or more employees by June 30, 2026, down to 5 to 9 employees by June 30, 2028. Sources conflict on penalties (up to $100 or up to $500 per employee after a warning period).

appliesWhen.description: 5 or more employees in the state

exemptions: Employers that sponsor a qualified retirement plan (they still certify the exemption)
